question: For subnet ID '012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48' (IPv4 only), list the top 10 subnets by number of distinct subnet routes, showing each subnet’s name and CIDR, total distinct routes, whether it has any IP allocation pools, and (for the same subnet name) the tenant-level average route-count range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of routes per subnet as computed per next hop. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT s.id AS subnet_id, s.name, s.tenant_id, s.cidr,
         COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination) AS total_routes,
         MAX(CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_ip_allocation_pools
  FROM subnets s
  LEFT JOIN subnetroutes r ON r.subnet_id = s.id
  LEFT JOIN ipallocationpools p ON p.subnet_id = s.id
  WHERE s.ip_version = 4
    AND s.id = '012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48'
  GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.tenant_id, s.cidr
),
per_nexthop AS (
  SELECT s.id AS subnet_id, s.name, s.tenant_id, r.nexthop,
         COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination) AS route_count
  FROM subnets s
  JOIN subnetroutes r ON r.subnet_id = s.id
  WHERE s.ip_version = 4
    AND s.id = '012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48'
  GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.tenant_id, r.nexthop
),
tenant_stats AS (
  SELECT tenant_id, name,
         AVG(route_count) AS avg_route_count,
         MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range,
         VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance,
         STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev
  FROM per_nexthop
  GROUP BY tenant_id, name
)
SELECT b.name, b.cidr, b.total_routes, b.has_ip_allocation_pools,
       t.avg_route_count, t.route_count_range, t.route_count_variance, t.route_count_stddev
FROM base b
JOIN tenant_stats t ON t.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND t.name = b.name
ORDER BY b.total_routes DESC
LIMIT 10;

  SELECT s.id AS subnet_id, s.name, s.tenant_id, s.cidr,
         COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination) AS total_routes,
         MAX(CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_ip_allocation_pools
  FROM subnets s
  LEFT JOIN subnetroutes r ON r.subnet_id = s.id
  LEFT JOIN ipallocationpools p ON p.subnet_id = s.id
  WHERE s.ip_version = 4
    AND s.id = '012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48'
  GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.tenant_id, s.cidr
),
per_nexthop AS (
  SELECT s.id AS subnet_id, s.name, s.tenant_id, r.nexthop,
         COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination) AS route_count
  FROM subnets s
  JOIN subnetroutes r ON r.subnet_id = s.id
  WHERE s.ip_version = 4
    AND s.id = '012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48'
  GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.tenant_id, r.nexthop
),
tenant_stats AS (
  SELECT tenant_id, name,
         AVG(route_count) AS avg_route_count,
         MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range,
         VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance,
         STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev
  FROM per_nexthop
  GROUP BY tenant_id, name
)
SELECT b.name, b.cidr, b.total_routes, b.has_ip_allocation_pools,
       t.avg_route_count, t.route_count_range, t.route_count_variance, t.route_count_stddev
FROM base b
JOIN tenant_stats t ON t.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND t.name = b.name
ORDER BY b.total_routes DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH subnet_routes AS (
  SELECT s.id AS subnet_id, s.name AS subnet_name, s.cidr AS subnet_cidr, s.tenant_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT sr.destination) AS distinct_route_count
  FROM subnets s LEFT JOIN subnetroutes sr ON s.id=sr.subnet_id
  WHERE s.ip_version=4
  GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.cidr, s.tenant_id
),
ip_pools AS (
  SELECT subnet_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)>0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_ip_pools
  FROM ipallocationpools GROUP BY subnet_id
),
route_counts_per_nexthop AS (
  SELECT s.tenant_id, s.id AS subnet_id, sr.nexthop,
         COUNT(DISTINCT sr.destination) AS route_count
  FROM subnets s JOIN subnetroutes sr ON s.id=sr.subnet_id
  WHERE s.ip_version=4
  GROUP BY s.tenant_id, s.id, sr.nexthop
),
tenant_stats AS (
  SELECT tenant_id,
         AVG(route_count) AS avg_route_count,
         MAX(route_count)-MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range,
         VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance,
         STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev
  FROM route_counts_per_nexthop GROUP BY tenant_id
)
SELECT sr.subnet_name, sr.subnet_cidr, sr.distinct_route_count,
       COALESCE(ip.has_ip_pools,'No') AS has_ip_allocation_pools,
       ts.avg_route_count, ts.route_count_range, ts.route_count_variance, ts.route_count_stddev
FROM subnet_routes sr
LEFT JOIN ip_pools ip ON sr.subnet_id=ip.subnet_id
LEFT JOIN tenant_stats ts ON sr.tenant_id=ts.tenant_id
ORDER BY sr.distinct_route_count DESC
LIMIT 10
